title: Cheaply designed mirror with one brightness setting
text:
Cheaply designed mirror with one brightness setting. This mirror feels cheap. It has a cheap plastic base that looks and feels like a frisbee. There is a plastic post that connects the mirror to the base. I was unable to get that to seat all the way into the mirror itself. The base seated fine and locked in place, but I felt like I was going to break the mirror by trying to get it seated on top so I quit trying since it remained sturdy as is even if the base's name tag did not center correctly with the mirror.

It has to be charged for several hours first. The charging port is on the back of the mirror next to the power button. It comes with a charging cable but not the A/C adapter. However, most people have wall adapters for micro USB cables, so this is not a problem. It also comes with one small round 10X mangifying mirror that can be affixed to the front of the larger mirror via the suction cups.

To power on the mirror, just turn the button on in the back after it is fully charged. That button can remain on. I just press the on/off circular power switch at the bottom of the mirror and the light turns on and off with a touch. There is only one brightness level but it is suitable for tweezing or applying make-up. The mirror head also tilts for better visibility.

Since the base is concave, bobby pins and other small accessories or change can be put in this tray without falling all over the place.

For the current price of $19.98 for the pink mirror, it is okay and functional. Personally, I do not expect this to last, especially since I cannot seem to get the connecting rod fully seated into the top of the mirror as can be seen in the photo where I am charging it.
